name: validate_delivery_date
description: Validate and normalize delivery dates with intelligent parsing. Handles ordinal numbers (30th sept), relative dates (tomorrow), and applies intelligent year assumptions.

is_valid.description: Whether the date is valid for delivery (must be today or a future date). If the user provides a full date including a year (e.g., '1 December 2025'), it must not be in the past—otherwise it is invalid. If the user provides a date without a year (e.g., '2 Dec'), interpret it as the next upcoming occurrence, which may fall in the next year.

normalized_date.description: The final normalized date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Should be provided if is_valid is true, null only if the date cannot be parsed or is invalid.

validation_issues.description: List of validation issues found (empty if valid)

user_friendly_message.description: User-friendly message explaining the validation result or the parsed date

confidence.description: Confidence in the date interpretation and validation (0-100)

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of how the date was parsed and validated
